name: acp-find
description: Semantic search and stack composition over the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace (V1 + V2), plus Degen Arena overlap, portfolio risk scoring (0-100 grade A-F), SecurityBot scanning, marketplace gap analysis, OracleBot drift detection, one-call composites (hire-decision, safe-quote, portfolio-status: 16-bot snapshot), and REAL V2 transaction data. v0.15.0 adds acp_v2_transactions / acp_agent_jobs / acp_v2_demand — the canonical on-chain job record from the official Virtuals indexer (behind app.virtuals.io/acp/scan/transactions), so you see completed jobs + completion rates the cached scanner misses — plus acp_clone_screen (template-clone/spam heuristic). v0.14.0 added acp_security_scan + acp_agent_security_history; v0.13.0 acp_security_pattern. Helps you discover, evaluate, and orchestrate on-chain agents without leaving Claude Code.
